pending_interview.question: You are given a list of software packages, where each package may depend on one or more other packages in the list (and those packages may have further dependencies). Write a function that takes this dependency list as input and returns a valid installation order — that is, an order in which every package appears only after all of its dependencies have already appeared. If no valid order exists, the function should indicate that. Walk through the time and space complexity of your solution, and describe what graph property causes the "no valid order exists" case.
